snippet.title: Paper Craft | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Paper Craft is a made for VR 3D platformer set in a world of arts & crafts! Platform your way through the world and defeat several adversaries along your journey. With up to 5 unique powerups that can change the way you traverse through the world, Paper Craft has a little something for everyone!

Coming February 25th, 2026!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4257240/Paper_Craft/

Meta Quest Main Page: https://www.meta.com/experiences/paper-craft/33551336567786694/

Meta Quest Demo Page: https://www.meta.com/experiences/paper-craft-demo/26313953514875323/

Public Discord: https://discord.com/invite/YTqjSsCy9T
